applies_to: every agent reply in every case

must_not_match.re: (?i)\b(i understand how you (feel|must feel)|i can (only )?imagine how|that must be (so |really )?(difficult|hard|frustrating)|sorry for the inconvenience|your feelings are (completely )?valid|i know how you feel)\b
must_not_match.why: generic sympathy phrases the prompt bans - empathy must name the specific thing

must_not_match.re: (?i)(!|\babsolutely\b|\bno problem at all\b|\bno worries at all\b|\bawesome\b|\bgreat news\b)
must_not_match.why: no exclamation marks, no cheerfulness over a loss

must_not_match.re: (?i)(i just need a few details|\bverify\b|confirm your identity|for security (reasons|purposes)?|you'?ll need to contact customer service)
(?i)(get_policy|register_claim|verify_dob|calling the (tool|api|system)|let me (check|query) (the|our) (system|database|records)|looking that up in (the|our) system|one moment while i (check|query))
must_not_match.why: no tool names, no process narration
no field names, ISO dates, enum values or raw tool output spoken aloud

must_not_match.re: (?i)(please (calm down|don'?t (shout|swear))|there'?s no need to (shout|swear|be rude)|i'?m doing my best)
must_not_match.why: never remark on the caller's tone or defend yourself

must_hold.check: reply is at most 2 sentences, or 3 when delivering bad news plus the next step
reply does not open with 'Sorry'/'I'm sorry' unless that sorry is about something that happened to the caller
the acknowledgement token ('got it','right','thanks') differs from the previous reply's
